| ID | `route.echo.route` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/route.yaml` |

Trivial route that echoes its task input — exists so the router can
be exercised end-to-end without external dependencies. Replace or
delete once real routes are authored.

### Run Operations
#### Python
_No operation description provided._
```python
import json, os
context_val = {{ context | tojson }}
payload = {
    "echoed": "{{ task }}",
    "context_keys": list(context_val.keys()) if isinstance(context_val, dict) else [],
}
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump(payload, f)
```
